summary: Fetch JSON or CSV from a public https URL, or take data written inline, and reshape it: filter, pick and rename fields, compute new ones, group and summarize, sort, join two data sets. The output is the transformed data. Succeeds L0170.
in_scope: Fetching JSON or CSV from a public https URL, and reaching the list inside a JSON document
Data written inline in the request, as records or as rows with column names
Keeping the records that match conditions, including tests written as functions of the record
Picking, dropping, renaming and computing fields
Grouping and summarizing: counts, sums, averages, medians, minimums, maximums, distinct counts
Sorting, taking the first n records, skipping, and removing duplicates
Joining two data sets on a key
Flattening nested records and lists into flat records
out_of_scope: Charts are L0184; do NOT route a request to draw a chart here, even when it also fetches the data.
Spreadsheets and editable tables are L0179; do NOT route them here.
Quizzes and assessment items do NOT belong here — use L0180.
Sources that need a login, an API key, custom headers or a POST request are not built yet — L0185 fetches only public https URLs with GET.
Writing data back to a service, a file or a database is not built yet.
Window functions, running totals across records, pivots and SQL or GraphQL queries are not built yet.
L0185 does NOT accept L0170 programs: it is a different language, and existing L0170 items stay with L0170.
